source_text: However, a 2016 prospective study found significantly shorter flaccid (6.78 cm vs. 7.65 cm, p<0.001) and erectile (12.97 cm vs. 13.75 cm, p=0.001) penile lengths in men circumcised neonatally compared to those circumcised later in life, suggesting that neonatal timing may influence adult penile length.
